title: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.33588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews.   Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. translated_title: 开发者作为AI智能体的管理者：一项工作场所跟随观察研究
translated_abstract: 随着AI编程智能体变得更加自主，开发者越来越多地需要指导、协调和检查它们的工作。然而，关于这些实践在日常专业开发中如何展开，目前知之甚少。我们对11名专业开发者进行了约15小时的工作跟随观察，对他们的活动和任务切换进行了编码，分析了255条提交的提示词，并开展了4.6小时的后续访谈。开发者平均将33.4%的观察时间用于编写提示词或检查AI响应，任务切换率在每小时0次到101.6次之间。除了产出工件之外，提示词还承担着促进理解、澄清需求、配置智能体以及协调沟通等功能。我们识别出三种反复出现的行为模式：*监督者*（Supervisor），即直接检查AI产出的工件；*委派者*（Delegator），即通过对话进行协调并将实现与检查工作委派给智能体；*学习者*（Learner），即主要借助智能体来构建……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对11名专业开发者的工作场所跟随观察，首次系统揭示了开发者在日常工作中管理自主AI编程智能体的三种模式——监督者、委派者和学习者，并发现开发者约三分之一的时间用于编写提示词和检查AI响应。
en_tdlr: Through a workplace shadowing study of 11 professional developers, this paper identifies three recurring patterns—Supervisor, Delegator, and Learner—in how developers manage autonomous AI coding agents, finding they spend about a third of their time formulating prompts and checking AI responses.
